text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: prod-eu high tail latency detected. 99th percentile > 1.2s over 3m. Automatic failover to eu-backup started (policy: regional-failover-v2). Notifying #eng-sre and oncall.
alice.nguyen: ack — I'm oncall. switchover was triggered, can someone pull the last deploy and recent config changes?
bob.kaplan: looking. no deployments in the last 24h in eu. seeing a spike in KV cache misses and a storm of small ephemeral requests hitting the /chat/stream endpoint.
carla: any customer-facing errors? support?
eve_support: RM: a handful of users reported slow responses in EU app 10:35-10:44 UTC, no error pages, just timeouts on long prompts. Logged two support tickets so far.
alice.nguyen: good. attaching quick traces from jaeger, showing hot partitioning on kv-node-7.
---trace snippet---
span: serving.request -> kv.fetch (node=kv-node-7) duration 874ms
span: serving.generate -> kernel dispatch 120ms
---end---
bob.kaplan: looks like the KV node gRPC connections were saturated. root cause likely a client behavior change (prefix churn) + eviction thrash. I'm rebalancing keys from kv-node-7 to kv-node-3/5 to reduce tail.
dave_platform: rebalancing in progress — starting migrate shards 7->3,5. ETA ~3m.
alice.nguyen: while that's happening: initiating temporary alert suppressions to avoid noisy paging. We'll silence the eu-99th alert for 10m with annotation "failover in progress / mitigation".
ops-bot: Alert eu-serving-99p suppressed by alice.nguyen for 10m. Reason: regional failover and shard rebalance.
bob.kaplan: rebalance finished. KV miss rate dropped ~60%, 99p latency trending down. Observed spike in preemptive cache evictions; need a param tweak.
carla: can we avoid automatic failover in this case? it added customer-visible re-routes and increased cold-cache misses.
alice.nguyen: good point. Current policy triggers on 99p > 1s for 2 consecutive windows. suggest updating runbook to add a second-signal requirement (cache-miss-rate > 0.2) before failover.
carla: +1. That will reduce flapping when it's cache-related.
---investigation notes---
PromQL extracts:
  // 99th p50 over 5m
  histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{region="eu",job="serving"}[5m])) by (le))
KV miss rate:
  sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total{region="eu"}[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{region="eu"}[1m]))
---end---
bob.kaplan: for post-incident: propose: 1) increase cache size on kv-pool-eu by 15% to reduce evictions, 2) add a short adaptive cooldown on automatic failover, 3) create a multi-region dashboard panel showing request reroutes + cold-cache ratio.
carla: also add alert noise controls: move eu-serving-99p into a two-signal alert that requires either error-rate > 0.5% OR kv_miss_rate > 0.15, otherwise raise to P2 not P1.
dave_platform: I can add the dashboard and panels in Grafana. I'll add a dedicated 'Regional Health / Failover' panel with: traffic by region, reroute rate, cold-cache ratio, and failover events timeline. Draft link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/REGIONAL-HEALTH (placeholder)
alice.nguyen: assigning mitigation tasks: SRE-4823 created for cache param + cooldown. I'll own alert tuning; bob please write the rule changes and tests.
bob.kaplan: will do. Proposed alert rule change (diff):
```yaml
- alert: EUServingHighTail
- expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{region="eu"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.0
- for: 2m
- severity: page
+ alert: EUServingHighTail_TwoSignal
+ expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{region="eu"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.0) and
+       ( (sum(rate(http_request_errors_total{region="eu"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{region="eu"}[5m])) ) > 0.005 or
+         (sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total{region="eu"}[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{region="eu"}[1m])) ) > 0.15)
+ for: 3m
+ severity: page
```
alice.nguyen: that looks good. Add annotations to include current runbook link and last-deploy-id.
eve_support: after we stabilize, please prepare a short customer impact summary for the support tickets and post to #customer-success. They want a clear timeline and root cause statement.
carla: agree. Also we should update the runbook section 'regional-failover-v2' to note: "Do not fail over on isolated KV cache thrash unless additional signals (error rate or sustained 99p) are present." I'll send a PR.
alice.nguyen: handoff: I'm taking on the postmortem writeup; bob will drive alert rule PR; dave will add Grafana panels; carla will update runbook; eve will coordinate customer comms. Handoff to bob for next 2 hours.
bob.kaplan: taking over. I'll post the alert PR and test snapshots.
ops-bot: On-call handover: alice.nguyen -> bob.kaplan at 10:58 UTC.
alice.nguyen: final notes: created incident ticket INC-2026, linked SRE-4823 and DSG-117 for dashboard. Next steps: schedule 1hr post-incident review tomorrow.
bob.kaplan: quick follow-ups I'll do in this thread: 1) PR link to alert rule change, 2) test results, 3) Grafana panel screenshots once Dave posts.
dave_platform: dashboard draft up at https://grafana.redwood.com/d/REGIONAL-HEALTH?orgId=1&view=draft — sharing screenshots in #eng-sre. I'll include failover event annotations.
carla: PR opened for runbook: https://git.redwood.com/runbooks/pull/89 — includes wording for 2-signal requirement.
eve_support: customer summary draft: "Between 10:32–10:44 UTC EU region experienced increased response latency due to KV cache eviction storm leading to automatic failover. Mitigation: shard rebalance and temporary cache size increase; no request loss but higher tail latency. Actions: alert tuning and runbook update to prevent unnecessary failovers. See INC-2026 for details." I'll post after review.
alice.nguyen: thanks team. tagging follow-ups for postmortem: owner=alice.nguyen, severity=P2 (reduced after failover), learnings: failover policy needs hysteresis; add multi-signal alerts; add regional health dashboard panels.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026 transitioned to postmortem state.
carla: closing log: latency back to normal baseline ~30m after mitigation.
---end of thread---
